pages.headline: 7' GOAL - Arsenal 1-0 Liverpool
pages.caption: Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Martin Odegaard. Arsenal 1-0 Liverpool.
pages.explanation: Goal at 7' made it Arsenal 1-0 Liverpool.

pages.headline: 15' Big chance - Arsenal
pages.caption: Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) hits the right post with a curling right footed shot from the right side of the box.

pages.headline: 22' Big chance - Arsenal
pages.caption: Attempt blocked. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) left footed shot from the left side of the box is blocked.

pages.headline: 38' Big chance - Liverpool
pages.caption: Attempt missed. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) header from the centre of the box misses to the left.

pages.headline: 44' GOAL - Arsenal 1-1 Liverpool
pages.caption: Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Trent Alexander-Arnold. Arsenal 1-1 Liverpool.
pages.explanation: Goal at 44' made it Arsenal 1-1 Liverpool.

pages.headline: 58' GOAL - Arsenal 2-1 Liverpool
pages.caption: Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) right footed shot from the centre of the box. Assisted by Bukayo Saka. Arsenal 2-1 Liverpool.
pages.explanation: Goal at 58' made it Arsenal 2-1 Liverpool.

pages.headline: 66' Big chance - Liverpool
pages.caption: Attempt saved. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) left footed shot from the centre of the box is saved in the top centre of the goal.

pages.headline: 87' Penalty decision
pages.caption: Penalty conceded by William Saliba (Arsenal) after a foul in the penalty area.

pages.headline: 87' Penalty awarded
pages.caption: Penalty Liverpool. Cody Gakpo draws a foul in the penalty area.

pages.headline: 88' PENALTY GOAL - Arsenal 2-2 Liverpool
pages.caption: Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner. Arsenal 2-2 Liverpool.
pages.explanation: Goal at 88' made it Arsenal 2-2 Liverpool.
